title: %coerceDate - convert a value to a date
purpose: Parse a string (or number/timestamp) into a typed date, dropping any time component.
notes: The quoted string becomes a bare date value (no quotes, no prefix) rendered as YYYY-MM-DD.
Many input shapes parse: ISO, YYYYMMDD, MM/DD/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, written months, and numeric Unix timestamps.
An unparseable value yields ~ (null) instead of an error.

avoid.why: an unrecognized date string silently becomes ~ (null), never an error
